Status_SoulSteal_Description: Increases in Melee Attack range by 2% for every stack. (Up to 50 stacks)
Status_ItemRarity_Jewelry_Description: A valuable, special artifact. When you acquire this artifact, you consume all of your <tag=Leaf>, and for every 200 <tag=Leaf> consumed, the artifact's maximum level increases by 1. (Up to a maximum of 5 levels)
Status_Excavation_Description: There's a 1% chance to acquire a <tag=JewelryCharm> for every 500 of owned <tag=Leaf>. Each time you acquire a <tag=JewelryCharm>, the required <tag=Leaf> increases by 100%.
Status_Looting_Description: Steals the target <tag=Leaf>. The number of <tag=Leaf> stolen increases based on the same chance as <tag=Evasion>.
Status_JewelryCount_Description: Number of times a <tag=JewelryCharm> has been acquired.
Status_MiniBossRewardDice_Name: Acquire {VALUE} dice upon defeating a mini boss
Status_MiniBossRewardDice_Description: Acquire {VALUE} dice upon defeating a mini boss.
Status_LeafSteal_Description: Gain <tag=Leaf> in proportion to the damage you inflict. (0.1% per point)
Status_ItemRarity_Armament_Description: A special artifact that replicates weapon attacks. Damage dealt by a Weapon Artifact is treated as damage from a <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack>.
Status_MachinaDamage_Description: Damage from Machine Artifacts is increased.
Status_MachinaAttackSpeed_Description: The cooldown of Machine Artifacts is reduced.
Status_MachinaRange_Description: The attack range of Machine Artifacts is increased.
Status_AdditionalRepair_Description: The maximum level of Machine Artifact in the <tag=MachineSlot> is further increased.
Status_MachineSlot_Description: This is a special inventory slot defined by a Machine Combo.
Status_SalvageSlot_Description: This is a special inventory slot defined by a Machine Combo.
Status_MechanicalConnect_Description: Refers to adjacent mechanical artifacts. This includes those next to the next ones as well.
Status_Crave_Description: <tag=AttackSpeed> increases by 1% per stack. It accumulates up to 25 stacks.
Status_JewelryCharm_Description: A rare, high-value artifact. Upon obtaining this artifact, you consume your held <tag=Leaf>; for every 500 <tag=Leaf> consumed, the maximum level increases by 1 (up to a maximum of 5 levels).
WeaponAddon_SwordAndShield_Fire_T3_Criti: Increases <tag=CriticalChance> by {VAL0}%. On critical hit, Phoenix Wing cooldown is reduced by {COOLDOWN} seconds.
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Evasion_T3_Another_Ef: <tag=WeaponAction_Fury> invincibility is treated as a <tag=Evasion> success effect. Upon a successful <tag=Evasion>, <tag=PhysicalDamage> increases by 5 for 8 seconds. (Maximum 4 stacks)
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Fury_T3_MP_Effect: Increases <tag=MPSkillDamage> by 20%. When performing a <tag=WeaponAction_Fury>, restores 20% of <tag=MP>.
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Flame_T3_Fury_Effect: When dealt <tag=FireDamage> 10 times, gain <tag=WeaponAction_Trance>. (<tag=WeaponAction_Trance> can be charged up to 2 times)
WeaponAddon_Katana_Ice_T3_Flame_Effect:
When performing a <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack>, deal additional damage to the target equal to 40% of <tag=FireDamage>.
Create 1 <tag=FlameSword> every {VAL0} seconds. The interval is reduced by {VAL1} for every 1% of <tag=FrostRelic> Charge Speed, and the number of <tag=FlameSword> created increases by 1 for every Additional activation of <tag=FrostRelic>.
WeaponAddon_Crossbow_Planet_T3_Weapon_Ef: Each time a planet deals damage, <tag=FinalWeaponDamage> increases, up to a maximum of 50%.
WeaponAddon_Crossbow_Planet_T3_Attack_Ef: When using <tag=WeaponAction_BasicAttack>, there's a 3% chance that planets will attack immediately.
WeaponAddon_GreatSword_Fire_T3_FlameSwor: When using <tag=WeaponAction_Sweep>, lost all <tag=FlameSword>, but create 12 <tag=FlameSword> and throw them around you.
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Ice_T2_Effect: When performing a <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack>, deal additional damage to the target equal to 20% of <tag=IceDamage>.
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Ice_T3_Frostbite_Effe:
On successful <tag=WeaponAction_Parry> with en enemy afflicted by <tag=Frostbite>, gain an additional <tag=WeaponAction_Trance>.
Damage dealt by <tag=WeaponAction_SpecialAttack> is changed to <tag=IceDamage>. <tag=WeaponAction_Fury> inflicts <tag=Frostbite>.
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Ice_T3_Frost_Effect:
On successful <tag=WeaponAction_Parry>, gain <tag=WeaponAction_IceTrance> instead of <tag=WeaponAction_Trance>.
On successful <tag=WeaponAction_Parry> with <tag=WeaponAction_IceTrance>, all <tag=FrostRelic> charge faster.
WeaponAddon_Dagger_Ice_T3_Magic_Effect: Increases <tag=IceDamage> by 6. On successful <tag=WeaponAction_Parry>, activates Frost Dagger
WeaponAddon_Staff_Sickle_T2_Effect: Damage dealt by <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack> is reduced by 20, but it is changed to <tag=HighestElementalDamage>.
WeaponAddon_Staff_Sickle_T3_Debuff_Effec: When performing a <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack>, there's a 30% chance to inflicts {DEBUFFS} for every 10 of the absolute value of <tag=Defense>.
WeaponAddon_Staff_Sickle_T3_Heal_Effect:
Each time you recover <tag=HP>, gain a <tag=SoulSteal> buff.
When deal <tag=Elemental_Chaos> Damage, consume up to 5 stacks, and <tag=CriticalChance> increases by 10% for each <tag=SoulSteal> stack consumed.
WeaponAddon_Staff_Flag_T3_Gold_Effect: When <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack> hits, there's a 1% chance of gaining the Gold Rush buff for every 1 of <tag=Negotiation>. When Gold Rush, gain <tag=Leaf> equal to 3% of the damage you dealt.
WeaponAddon_Staff_Flag_T3_Cheer_Effect: When <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack> hits, Tthere's a {PERCENT} chance to consume {LEAF} <tag=Leaf> and place an Banner of Encouragement that increases attack speed by {SPEED}.
WeaponAddon_Staff_Flag_T3_Roger_Effect:
<tag=Thorns> increases by {THORNS} for every 1 of <tag=Negotiation>.
Last Combo Damage of <tag=WeaponAction_BasicAttack> is changed to <tag=Thorns> Damage 80%.
WeaponAddon_Katana_Lightning_T3_Plasma_E:
Damage dealt by <tag=WeaponAction_SpecialAttack> is changed to <tag=FireDamage>. Continuously gain 'Blade Heat' when <tag=WeaponAction_Sheath>. When 'Blade Heat' is at 100%, gain Melting buff.
When Melting, damage dealt by <tag=WeaponAction_BasicAttack> is changed to <tag=FireDamage> 60% + <tag=LightningDamage> 60%, and there's a {PERCENT} chance to apply an <tag=Plasma> when using <tag=WeaponAction_BasicAttack>.
WeaponAddon_Katana_Lightning_T3_Cooldown:
Damage dealt by <tag=WeaponAction_BasicAttack> is changed to <tag=IceDamage> 80% + <tag=LightningDamage> 80%. When <tag=WeaponAction_BasicAttack> hits, activates <tag=SnowCloud> and gain 'Blade Heat'. When 'Blade Heat' is at 100%, it deals damage to you.
Damage dealt by <tag=WeaponAction_SpecialAttack> is changed to <tag=IceDamage>. Continuously lost 'Blade Heat' when <tag=WeaponAction_Sheath>.
Passive_Grimoire_Description: Recall various memories used in magic.

Passive_Vampire_Description: Pursue the principles befitting a king.
Passive_Vampire_Effect_LV5: Healing Recieved decreases by 25%, but <tag=MaxHP> increases by {VAL1}.
Passive_Vampire_Effect_LV10: Furthermore, Healing Recieved decreases by 25%, but <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack> inflicts <tag=Debuff_Poison>.
Passive_Vampire_Effect_LV20: <tag=Debuff_Poison> stacks increases by {VAL1}, <tag=HPSteal> with <tag=Elemental_Chaos> Damage increases by {VAL0}.
Passive_Movement_Description: My speed has always been my strong suit.
Passive_Movement_Effect_LV10: When <tag=WeaponAction_DirectAttack> hits, gain Gale buff. (Gale: <tag=TrueDamage> and <tag=Toughness> increases by {VAL0}. Up to {VAL1} stacks.)
